instruction.name: vaddwev.q.du
instruction.description: Add the even-positioned unsigned 64-bit elements in `a` and the corresponding unsigned 64-bit elements in `b`, extending both to 128-bit, and save the 128-bit result in `dst`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 3.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vaddwev.q.du $vr0, $vr8, $vr16; vaddwev.q.du $vr1, $vr9, $vr17; vaddwev.q.du $vr2, $vr10, $vr18; vaddwev.q.du $vr3, $vr11, $vr19; vaddwev.q.du $vr4, $vr12, $vr20; vaddwev.q.du $vr5, $vr13, $vr21; vaddwev.q.du $vr6, $vr14, $vr22; vaddwev.q.du $vr7, $vr15, $vr23
